title: Thinking on Cognitive vs Emotional Experiences & Models for Failure
summary: Divya and Kahran pick at the gap between what we know cognitively and what we feel about it — flat-earth belief, gun violence in America, foolishness vs being a fool. From there they build a working model of 'good failure vs bad failure,' how acknowledging failure sharpens what you actually want, and why iterating only ever finds local maxima.

intents.display: to build a better mental model for failure and how to learn from it
